resolution.note: legacy 17-record capture adopts exit 0, second run byte-identical; test/adopt/legacy-records.test.ts

title: krn adopt upgrades standards records written by an older krn instead of refusing them
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-16, S29 probe: `krn adopt . --tracker` in a fresh clone of the pilot krn-works/seo-audit-harness (adopted by an earlier krn, #83/#88 there) exits 65: '.agents/standards.json: records[0].type: Invalid option'. Capture: .krn/runs/lead/s29/pilot-standards.json (17 records, no type, top-level why/evidence, no provenance).
Outcome: `krn adopt` on a repository whose .agents/standards.json was written by an older krn (records without type/provenance, top-level evidence) exits 0 and rewrites the file in the current schema with every record id kept; a rerun changes nothing.
Why: every schema change otherwise breaks each adopted repository until someone hand-edits it (the pilot needed #88 for tier); S29 cannot adopt the pilot.
Proof: node --test test/brain/record.test.ts (legacy pilot capture parses) and an adopt test on a fixture repo carrying the capture: exit 0, ids preserved, second run byte-identical.
Files: src/brain/record.ts, src/adopt/
